name: Restriction Reference 1 Code
definition: Specifies the restriction references to be applied to a transaction.

ADDC.name: Add Cash Restriction Reference
ADDC.definition: Addition of a cash restriction reference representing a cash sub-balance to be utilised within the settlement instruction for the debiting or crediting of cash.

ADDS.name: Add Securities Restriction Reference
ADDS.definition: Addition of a securities restriction reference representing a securities sub-position to be utilised within the settlement instruction for the delivery or receipt of securities.

REMC.name: Remove Cash Restriction Reference
REMC.definition: Removal of a cash restriction reference, already present within the settlement instruction, representing a cash sub-balance to be utilised within the settlement instruction for the debiting or crediting of cash.

REMS.name: Remove Securities Restriction Reference
REMS.definition: Removal of a securities restriction reference, already present within the settlement instruction, representing a securities sub-position to be utilised within the settlement instruction for the delivery or receipt of securities.
